variables.name: chosen
variables.notes: Species number of the monster walking the menu map, picked in its cave (0 Furrbit, 1 Emberpup, 2 Splashell, 3 Voltail, 4 Sproutle, 5 Venomole, 6 Gustling, 7 Wispook, 8 Pebbulk). Kept between runs and saved, so the last pick is still selected after switching the game off.

variables.name: world
variables.notes: The world of this run, by type, in the order of game.battle.types: 0 Normal (Green Meadow), 1 Fire (Ember Crater), 2 Water (Coral Lagoon), 3 Electric (Storm Plateau), 4 Grass (Verdant Jungle), 5 Poison (Miasma Swamp), 6 Flying (Sky Isle), 7 Ghost (Haunted Hollow), 8 Rock (Boulder Canyon). It picks the run's ground and border maps, and which monsters are at home (their type = the world's: +10% power, +10% speed, -10% recharge for wild ones, half that for the player's monster). Each new run from the monster picker draws one at random (every world is always open); RESTART keeps it, since it is persistent and reset_vars leaves it alone.

variables.name: unlocked
variables.notes: How many monsters can be picked, counting from Furrbit in the roster order above (1 = only Furrbit, the Normal type, at the start; 9 = all). Each is freed on the menu map, in roster order: winning a land's challenge adds 1 (Emberpup in the Boulder Canyon, Splashell in the Verdant Jungle, Voltail in the Ember Crater, Sproutle in the Coral Lagoon, Venomole on the Storm Plateau, Gustling in the Miasma Swamp, Wispook on the Sky Isle, Pebbulk in the Haunted Hollow). Classic wins no longer unlock monsters. At 9 the waves mode opens. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress puts it back to 1.

variables.name: new_mon
variables.notes: Species number of the monster just freed on the menu map (the banner names it). -1 = none.

variables.name: hp
variables.notes: The player's hit points.

variables.name: hp_max
variables.notes: The player's maximum hit points.

variables.name: level
variables.notes: The player's level (1-25).

variables.name: xp
variables.notes: Total XP collected this run.

variables.name: xp_pct
variables.notes: Progress to the next level, 0-100 (the XP bar).

variables.name: kills
variables.notes: Monsters defeated: this run (25 wins it), or, on the menu map, this screen's guards (back to 0 on every screen change: a challenge starts over).

variables.name: time
variables.notes: Seconds since the run started.

variables.name: time_min
variables.notes: Run timer minutes.

variables.name: time_sec
variables.notes: Run timer seconds.

variables.name: g1
variables.notes: Move 1's charge gauge (0 locked, 1-5 empty to full, 6 flash).

variables.name: g2
variables.notes: Move 2's charge gauge.

variables.name: g3
variables.notes: Move 3's charge gauge.

variables.name: moves
variables.notes: How many moves are unlocked (1-3).

variables.name: run_over
variables.notes: Set when the run is won or lost (stops the timer).

variables.name: new_best
variables.notes: Set on the victory screen when this run beat the monster's best time (or was its first win): the screen then says NEW BEST TIME!.

variables.name: best_time
variables.notes: Fastest won run of each menu entry, in seconds: slots 0-8 = the 9 monsters' classic runs, in roster order (best_time[chosen] on the classic victory screen), slots 9-17 = their waves runs (best_time[entry]). -1 = never won, shown as --:--. Each victory screen keeps the smaller of it and the run's time. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress erases them all.

variables.name: boss_level
variables.notes: The Alpha's level. Each run starts it at 5; every whole minute on the run clock adds 1 (1:00 = 6, 2:00 = 7 ... 10:00 = 15, the most) while fewer than 24 wild monsters have fainted. Once all 24 are down the Alpha wakes and its level stays where it is.

variables.name: boss_species
variables.notes: The classic Alpha's species this run, in roster order (0 Furrbit ... 8 Pebbulk): a random one, never the player's, written by the Alpha itself when the run starts (its monster behavior's species_out_var). When it faints this decides the shiny seed: it leaves one only if this number is below 'unlocked' (the monster can be picked) and its slot of 'shiny' is still 0.

variables.name: boss_up
variables.notes: Classic run only: set for 3 s each time the run clock raises the sleeping Alpha's level (every whole minute while it sleeps, up to level 15), so the run HUD shows BOSS LV+1 in the bottom-right corner.

variables.name: sign
variables.notes: Set for 3 s when a run starts (classic and waves), right after the fade-in: the run HUD then shows the world's name (the 'world' variable) in the middle near the top, like a location sign. The words over the player at the start and the waves mode's first wave wait until it is gone.

variables.name: boost_speed
variables.notes: Speed points from the Swift Feather (the floor item, a win's item, the waves level-up card): each is +5% walking speed for the player (its topdown_controller speed_step). Back to 0 each run.

variables.name: boost_power
variables.notes: Extra damage percent of all the player's moves, from the Power Gem (+5 for the floor item and a win's item; +2, +1, +2, +1, +2 for the waves level-up card's 5 levels) and the garden's POWER UPs (+2, +1, +2, +1, +2). Back to 0 each run.

variables.name: boost_aim
variables.notes: Accuracy points added to the player's moves, from the Aim Charm (+3 for the floor item and a win's item: they miss 3% less; +3, +2, +3, +2 for the waves level-up card's 4 levels). Back to 0 each run.

variables.name: boost_dodge
variables.notes: Accuracy points taken off wild monsters' moves aimed at the player, from the Mist Orb (+5 for the floor item and a win's item: they miss 5% more; +3, +2, +3 for the waves level-up card's 3 levels). Back to 0 each run.

variables.name: boost_charge
variables.notes: Percent cut from the recharge time of all the player's moves, from the Quick Hourglass (+5 for the floor item and a win's item, +4 for each level of the waves level-up card). Back to 0 each run.

variables.name: mode
variables.notes: The game mode started from the menu map: 0 = the classic run (the CLASSIC sign), 1 = the waves run (the WAVES sign). Set by the sign when the run starts, kept between runs and saved.

variables.name: entry
variables.notes: The run being played: mode x 9 + chosen (0-8 the classic runs, 9-17 the waves runs), set when a sign starts it. Picks the best_time slot the waves victory screen keeps and the shiny_runs slot. Walking up to the CLASSIC or WAVES sign of the menu sets it too (to that sign's run), so the menu's bottom line shows that run's best time.

variables.name: spot
variables.notes: Which sign of the menu map the monster stands by: 0 none, 1 CLASSIC, 2 CLEAR SAVE, 3 WAVES, 10 the locked WAVES sign (its label says WAVES and the bottom line how many monster types are still to free) (set by the signs' zones, trg_sign, trg_sign_waves and trg_sign_locked); its name shows over the monster's head. 9 while a run is starting, so a second A / B press does nothing.

variables.name: wave
variables.notes: The wave being fought in the waves mode (1-10; 0 before the first). Set by the wave director.

variables.name: wave_left
variables.notes: Monsters of the current wave still to defeat (the boss included), for the waves pause menu.

variables.name: wave_banner
variables.notes: The wave whose name shows in the middle of the screen (WAVE 3, FINAL WAVE!) for 2 s when it starts; 0 = none.

variables.name: up_power
variables.notes: Level of the Power Gem level-up card in this waves run (0 = not taken yet, up to 5).

variables.name: up_speed
variables.notes: Level of the Swift Feather level-up card in this waves run (0 = not taken yet, up to 4).

variables.name: up_aim
variables.notes: Level of the Aim Charm level-up card in this waves run (0 = not taken yet, up to 4).

variables.name: up_dodge
variables.notes: Level of the Mist Orb level-up card in this waves run (0 = not taken yet, up to 3).

variables.name: up_charge
variables.notes: Level of the Hourglass level-up card in this waves run (0 = not taken yet, up to 5).

variables.name: up_vital
variables.notes: Level of the Vital Seed level-up card in this waves run (0 = not taken yet, up to 5).

variables.name: drop_kind
variables.notes: Helper for the waves mode's drops: the item a fainting wave monster just rolled (0 Swift Feather, 1 Power Gem, 2 Aim Charm, 3 Mist Orb, 4 Quick Hourglass).

variables.name: drops
variables.notes: How many of each item the wave monsters have dropped in this waves run, in the order of drop_kind. Each item drops at most 3 times per run: a faint that rolls an item already at 3 drops nothing. Back to 0 each run.

variables.name: shiny
variables.notes: Which monsters are shiny, one slot per monster in roster order (0 Furrbit ... 8 Pebbulk): 1 = shiny. A shiny monster shimmers through the rainbow wherever it shows (in the run, on the menu, on the victory screens), in both modes its moves hit 20% harder and it starts each run with 40% more HP. Only the classic mode makes monsters shiny: when the Alpha faints, if its species is unlocked and still plain, it leaves a shiny seed, and winning that run with the seed picked up makes the Alpha's species shiny (the victory screen sets its slot and saves). Each species can only become shiny once, so its Alpha leaves no seed after that; which seed comes is as random as the Alpha. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress makes them all plain again.

variables.name: new_shiny
variables.notes: The monster (roster number) this classic run's win makes shiny: the Alpha's species, set when the Alpha faints and leaves a shiny seed. The victory screen makes it shiny and saves; START on the items screen then opens the shiny screen, which shows it. -1 = none (no seed this run, or a waves run: START goes straight back to the menu). Every classic run starts at -1.

variables.name: prize_1
variables.notes: Item 1 of the 3 items the last won run gave (any mode, any monster, every win, even a run won before), waiting for the next run: 0 = none, 1 Swift Feather, 2 Power Gem, 3 Aim Charm, 4 Mist Orb, 5 Quick Hourglass. Rolled by the victory screen (3 different ones, prize_1 < prize_2 < prize_3), shown by the items screen, used up when the next run starts (set back to 0 then, the boosts kept for that run). Saved; a new win replaces them, they never add up.

variables.name: prize_2
variables.notes: Item 2 of the 3 items the last won run gave (any mode, any monster, every win, even a run won before), waiting for the next run: 0 = none, 1 Swift Feather, 2 Power Gem, 3 Aim Charm, 4 Mist Orb, 5 Quick Hourglass. Rolled by the victory screen (3 different ones, prize_1 < prize_2 < prize_3), shown by the items screen, used up when the next run starts (set back to 0 then, the boosts kept for that run). Saved; a new win replaces them, they never add up.

variables.name: prize_3
variables.notes: Item 3 of the 3 items the last won run gave (any mode, any monster, every win, even a run won before), waiting for the next run: 0 = none, 1 Swift Feather, 2 Power Gem, 3 Aim Charm, 4 Mist Orb, 5 Quick Hourglass. Rolled by the victory screen (3 different ones, prize_1 < prize_2 < prize_3), shown by the items screen, used up when the next run starts (set back to 0 then, the boosts kept for that run). Saved; a new win replaces them, they never add up.

variables.name: prize_roll
variables.notes: Helper for the victory screen's roll of the 3 items: which of the 10 ways to pick 3 different items out of 5 (0-9).

variables.name: used1
variables.notes: Item 1 this run started with (the last win's prize_1, same numbers, 0 = none): its boost was added when the run started; the player's monster floats its words when it appears. Back to 0 each run.

variables.name: used2
variables.notes: Item 2 this run started with (the last win's prize_2, same numbers, 0 = none): its boost was added when the run started; the player's monster floats its words when it appears. Back to 0 each run.

variables.name: used3
variables.notes: Item 3 this run started with (the last win's prize_3, same numbers, 0 = none): its boost was added when the run started; the player's monster floats its words when it appears. Back to 0 each run.

variables.name: hp_ups
variables.notes: HP UP items picked up from the menu's garden (0-5). Each one gives the player's monster 5 more HP (and max HP) at the start of every run, in both modes, with any monster, on top of everything else (species, shiny, items): 5 = +25 HP. Added silently when the run scene starts, so a RESTART gets them again, just the same. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress puts it back to 0.

variables.name: power_ups
variables.notes: POWER UP items picked up from the menu's garden (0-5). They make every move of the player's monster hit harder (boost_power) in every run, in both modes, with any monster: +2% for the 1st, 3rd and 5th, +1% for the 2nd and 4th (1.5% each, taking turns since there are no half percents): 5 = +8%. Added silently when the run scene starts, so a RESTART gets them again, just the same. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress puts it back to 0.

variables.name: plot_1
variables.notes: What garden plot 1 of the menu holds (0 soil, 1 seed, 2 sprout, 3 young plant, 4 budding plant, 5 full grown (golden flower), 6 HP UP ripe on the soil, 7 POWER UP ripe on the soil; prop_plot shows it). After each finished run (won or lost) the menu grows it one step: 1 to 4 add 1, 5 ripens into 6 or 7 at random, so an item takes 5 finished runs from planting, never more than 5 HP UPs or 5 POWER UPs in all (owned + ripe). Walking onto a ripe item picks it up and puts the plot back to 0. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress empties it.

variables.name: plot_2
variables.notes: What garden plot 2 of the menu holds (0 soil, 1 seed, 2 sprout, 3 young plant, 4 budding plant, 5 full grown (golden flower), 6 HP UP ripe on the soil, 7 POWER UP ripe on the soil; prop_plot shows it). After each finished run (won or lost) the menu grows it one step: 1 to 4 add 1, 5 ripens into 6 or 7 at random, so an item takes 5 finished runs from planting, never more than 5 HP UPs or 5 POWER UPs in all (owned + ripe). Walking onto a ripe item picks it up and puts the plot back to 0. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress empties it.

variables.name: plot_3
variables.notes: What garden plot 3 of the menu holds (0 soil, 1 seed, 2 sprout, 3 young plant, 4 budding plant, 5 full grown (golden flower), 6 HP UP ripe on the soil, 7 POWER UP ripe on the soil; prop_plot shows it). After each finished run (won or lost) the menu grows it one step: 1 to 4 add 1, 5 ripens into 6 or 7 at random, so an item takes 5 finished runs from planting, never more than 5 HP UPs or 5 POWER UPs in all (owned + ripe). Walking onto a ripe item picks it up and puts the plot back to 0. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress empties it.

variables.name: plot_4
variables.notes: What garden plot 4 of the menu holds (0 soil, 1 seed, 2 sprout, 3 young plant, 4 budding plant, 5 full grown (golden flower), 6 HP UP ripe on the soil, 7 POWER UP ripe on the soil; prop_plot shows it). After each finished run (won or lost) the menu grows it one step: 1 to 4 add 1, 5 ripens into 6 or 7 at random, so an item takes 5 finished runs from planting, never more than 5 HP UPs or 5 POWER UPs in all (owned + ripe). Walking onto a ripe item picks it up and puts the plot back to 0. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress empties it.

variables.name: grow_1
variables.notes: Finished runs (won or lost) garden plot 1 has counted toward its next growth step. The menu adds 1 after each finished run while the plot holds a plant (1-5: seed to full grown), and at 1 the plant grows one step (plot_1) and it goes back to 0: one step per finished run. Planting a seed starts it at 0. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress sets it to 0.

variables.name: grow_2
variables.notes: Finished runs (won or lost) garden plot 2 has counted toward its next growth step. The menu adds 1 after each finished run while the plot holds a plant (1-5: seed to full grown), and at 1 the plant grows one step (plot_2) and it goes back to 0: one step per finished run. Planting a seed starts it at 0. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress sets it to 0.

variables.name: grow_3
variables.notes: Finished runs (won or lost) garden plot 3 has counted toward its next growth step. The menu adds 1 after each finished run while the plot holds a plant (1-5: seed to full grown), and at 1 the plant grows one step (plot_3) and it goes back to 0: one step per finished run. Planting a seed starts it at 0. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress sets it to 0.

variables.name: grow_4
variables.notes: Finished runs (won or lost) garden plot 4 has counted toward its next growth step. The menu adds 1 after each finished run while the plot holds a plant (1-5: seed to full grown), and at 1 the plant grows one step (plot_4) and it goes back to 0: one step per finished run. Planting a seed starts it at 0. Saved on the cartridge; clearing the saved progress sets it to 0.

variables.name: run_seed
variables.notes: 1 once the player picked up the run's seed (item_seed / item_waves_seed). Kept only if the run is finished: the victory or game over screen saves it, and the menu plants it in the first empty garden plot. Quitting or restarting the run loses it (back to 0 each run).

variables.name: run_ended
variables.notes: 1 from the end of a finished run (set and saved by the victory and game over screens of both modes) until the menu opens: then every plant counts one more finished run (grow_1-4: 5 make one growth step), the run's seed is planted, and it goes back to 0 (saved). Quitting a run from the pause menu never sets it, so a quit run doesn't grow the garden.

variables.name: plots_used
variables.notes: Helper for the run scenes: how many of the 4 garden plots are in use (anything but empty soil). At 4, no seed lies on the map.

variables.name: items_total
variables.notes: Helper for the run scenes: hp_ups + power_ups + plots_used, the garden items owned or on their way. At 10 (5 HP UP + 5 POWER UP) no seed lies on the map: there is nothing left for a plant to give.

variables.name: hp_total
variables.notes: Helper for the menu's garden step: HP UPs owned + ripe on the soil, so a plant never ripens into a 6th HP UP.

variables.name: power_total
variables.notes: Helper for the menu's garden step: POWER UPs owned + ripe on the soil, so a plant never ripens into a 6th POWER UP.

variables.name: item_roll
variables.notes: Helper for the menu's garden step: which item a full-grown plant ripens into (0 = HP UP, 1 = POWER UP), at random unless one of them already has its 5.

variables.name: near
variables.notes: Which line the menu's bottom line shows by a sign: 1 at the CLASSIC sign or the open WAVES sign (their zones also put that run's best_time slot in 'entry'): BEST TIME and that monster's best time in that mode (--:-- if it never won it); 2 at the locked WAVES sign: how many monster types are still to free (8 MONSTER TYPES LEFT ... 1 MONSTER TYPE LEFT); 0 nothing. A garden item's message shows first.

variables.name: msg_q
variables.notes: The menu's queue of garden item messages, in the order the items were picked up (4 plots, so 4 at most): 1-5 = HP UP, now owning that many (1/5 ... 5/5); 6-10 = POWER UP, owning 1-5. 0 = no message. The bottom line shows slot msg_i for 3 s each; emptied when the last one is done and whenever the menu opens.

variables.name: msg_n
variables.notes: How many garden item messages are queued in msg_q (0-4). The pickup that finds it empty (it becomes 1) shows the queue: each message 3 s, then the next, then it empties the queue.

variables.name: msg_i
variables.notes: Which queued garden item message (msg_q slot) the menu's bottom line shows now; past the last one it shows nothing (or a sign's best time).

variables.name: item_got
variables.notes: Helper for a garden pickup: the message code of the item just picked up (see msg_q), 0 when the plot held nothing ripe.

variables.name: map_hp
variables.notes: Hit points of the monster walking the menu map. Full whenever it appears (the map opening, walking out of the cave, waking up after a faint) and whenever it walks back into the Green Meadow; 0 makes it faint. Starts at 0 so the runs' start-of-run HP bonus never fires on the map.

variables.name: map_hp_max
variables.notes: Maximum hit points of the monster on the menu map: like a level-7 monster in a run (108; Furrbit 120; a shiny one 132, Furrbit 149) + 5 per garden HP UP. Set by plr_menu when it appears.

variables.name: map_level
variables.notes: The level of the monster on the menu map: always 7 (all 3 moves, no XP).

variables.name: map_power
variables.notes: Extra damage percent of the monster on the menu map: the garden's POWER UPs (+2, +1, +2, +1, +2). Set by plr_menu when it appears.

variables.name: map_moves
variables.notes: 1 while the monster on the menu map is outside the Green Meadow: A, B and R fire its moves (move_buttons enable_var). 0 in the Meadow, where A and B pick the signs.

variables.name: screen
variables.notes: The menu map's screen showing: row x 7 + column (A1 = 0 ... G7 = 48; the Green Meadow D4 = 24). Set by the screens camera on every change.

variables.name: land
variables.notes: The land of the menu map's screen: 0 Green Meadow, 1 Boulder Canyon, 2 Verdant Jungle, 3 Ember Crater, 4 Coral Lagoon, 5 Storm Plateau, 6 Miasma Swamp, 7 Sky Isle, 8 Haunted Hollow.

variables.name: prev_land
variables.notes: Helper of the menu map: the land before this screen change (its name shows when the land changes).

variables.name: land_sign
variables.notes: Above 0 for 3 s after walking into another land of the menu map: the top of the screen shows the land's name (each change adds 1 and takes it away 3 s later).

variables.name: hint
variables.notes: What the top of the menu map's screen says: 0 nothing; 1-7 what opens the gate the monster stands by (1 fire, 2 water, 3 electricity, 4 grass, 5 poison, 6 a flyer, 7 a ghost); 10 + land for 3 s on walking into a challenge screen: the garden items its fight is tuned for.

variables.name: banner
variables.notes: Set for 4 s when a monster is freed on the menu map: the middle of the screen says <NAME> UNLOCKED! / PICK IT IN THE CAVE (new_mon is the monster).

variables.name: garden_owned
variables.notes: Helper of the menu map: HP UPs + POWER UPs owned (0-10), for the challenge screens' BRING n GARDEN ITEMS / YOU HAVE n line.

variables.name: sw_1
variables.notes: The High Mesas (A1): 1 once the vine bridge from the entrance to the middle mesa grew. Back to 0 on every screen change, so the bridges grow back each visit, until Venomole is freed (then always 1).

variables.name: sw_2
variables.notes: The High Mesas (A1): 1 once the vine bridge to the left mesa grew (see sw_1).

variables.name: sw_3
variables.notes: The High Mesas (A1): 1 once the vine bridge to the right mesa grew (see sw_1).

variables.name: gate_2
variables.notes: 1 once the bramble wall on the menu map's way into the Verdant Jungle is gone (burnt by a fire move), for good: saved; clearing the saved progress puts it back. A save from before the big map gets it when 'unlocked' is above 2 (that land's monster was already won).

variables.name: gate_3
variables.notes: 1 once the wall of flames on the menu map's way into the Ember Crater is gone (put out by a water move), for good: saved; clearing the saved progress puts it back. A save from before the big map gets it when 'unlocked' is above 3 (that land's monster was already won).

variables.name: gate_4
variables.notes: 1 once the storm crystal on the menu map's way into the Coral Lagoon is gone (shattered by an electric move), for good: saved; clearing the saved progress puts it back. A save from before the big map gets it when 'unlocked' is above 4 (that land's monster was already won).

variables.name: gate_5
variables.notes: 1 once the ravine on the menu map's way into the Storm Plateau is gone (a grass move grew a vine bridge), for good: saved; clearing the saved progress puts it back. A save from before the big map gets it when 'unlocked' is above 5 (that land's monster was already won).

variables.name: gate_6
variables.notes: 1 once the boulder on the menu map's way into the Miasma Swamp is gone (melted by a poison move), for good: saved; clearing the saved progress puts it back. A save from before the big map gets it when 'unlocked' is above 6 (that land's monster was already won).
